title_en: Fall 2026 Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey: Period Extended to November 12
summary: The Fall 2026 Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey has been extended by one week and now runs from 29 October to 12 November 2026. All enrolled students are encouraged to take part through the mySNU portal.
applies_to: Students enrolled in undergraduate and graduate courses. All courses are covered except graduate 'Thesis Research' (논문연구) courses. Participation is encouraged, not stated as mandatory.

dates.what: Survey period (extended by one week; current period)
Original survey period (replaced by the extension)

steps: Log in to the mySNU portal (포털 마이스누).
Go to Basic Information (기본정보) → Classes/Grades (수업/성적) → Grades (성적) → Course Evaluation (강의평가).
For each eligible course, answer the free-response questions. Answer the two questions on online (non-face-to-face) classes only if they apply to the course.
Complete the survey by Thursday 12 November 2026.
translation:
Fall 2026 "Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey" (강의 중간 수강소감 조사): Notice (Period Extended: until Thursday 11/12)

The survey period for the Fall 2026 "Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey" has been extended as shown below. We ask all enrolled students to take part.

1. Survey period: Thursday 29 October 2026 to Thursday 5 November 2026 (original period)
1. Survey period: Thursday 29 October 2026 to Thursday 12 November 2026 ※ Extended by one week

2. How to participate: mySNU portal (포털 마이스누) → Basic Information (기본정보) → Classes/Grades (수업/성적) → Grades (성적) → Course Evaluation (강의평가)

3. Courses covered: All courses offered at the undergraduate and graduate levels (excluding graduate 'Thesis Research' [논문연구] courses)

4. Survey questions: Four free-response questions (the two questions on online classes should be answered only where applicable)
    ○ Please describe anything that was especially good or memorable about this course.
    ○ Please describe anything in this course that could be improved.
    ○ Please comment on whether the online teaching methods (live video classes, lecture videos, documents, assignments, etc.) were suitable for the nature of the course.
    ○ Please comment on your overall satisfaction with the online classes and anything that could be improved.

[Attachment] Guide to the Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey Program
Attached file (1): [붙임] 강의 중간 수강소감 조사 프로그램 안내.pdf (153 KB)

Note: The content of the attached PDF was not provided in the text of the notice and has not been read or translated.
